title: SuperDomains
tagline: SuperDomains is decentralised naming service built on Mode where users can register usernames on the Mode blockchain
description:
SuperDomains is decentralised naming service built on Mode. where users can register usernames on the Mode blockchain
Consists of multiple parts, a web app where users can buy and register their names and  an api which developers can use to integrate SuperDomains into their Mode dapps
how_its_made:
Made using solidity for smart contracts,
javascript in hardhat framework and for frontend as well,
chai for testing,
hardhat framework for deployment, compile, react, express.js in api and the  mode blockchain
git for version control,
and support from the mode team on discord
In future would like to deploy to all superchain networks
